creator: zubair_trabzada
topic: A voice-controlled Jarvis AI assistant phones a restaurant, negotiates a reservation, checks back with the boss, and books it

says.claim: You can build a Jarvis assistant that makes real phone calls on your behalf and reports back.
steps: Tell Jarvis to call the restaurant and book for three at 7 pm
Jarvis calls, learns 7 pm is full but 8 pm is open, and says it will check with the boss
Jarvis calls back, confirms, and reports the booking
prompts_or_templates: Free Jarvis build prompts (not shown on screen, offered in caption)
says.proof_shown: Real unedited demo: creator holds a phone that rings, the Jarvis HUD shows DIALING, ON THE CALL, ENDED with a call summary and recording link, both calls heard in full audio.

freebie.promised: Free Jarvis build prompts (from caption; not spoken)

hook.spoken: Jarvis, call the restaurant. Make a reservation for three people at 7 p.m. tonight.
hook.visual: Top half Jarvis HUD with ring and node graph, bottom half creator seated at mic in white tee, blue backlit studio

beats.what: Voice command to Jarvis, which replies Ringing the restaurant now
Jarvis phone call to the restaurant on speaker; creator holds phone to ear, HUD shows ON THE CALL
7 pm is unavailable, 8 pm offered; Jarvis says it will check with its boss
Jarvis reports back in butler voice; HUD card shows ENDED with call summary
Creator says 8 pm works, Jarvis calls back
Second call confirms booking; Jarvis jokes about the small victory
Black end card with AI Workshop logo, 'Watch the full Video, Link in the description' and pointing emoji
